Patriot League regular season champions |bowl=[[2013 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |bowl_result= Round of 64 }} {{2012–13 Patriot League men's basketball standings}} The '''2012–13 Bucknell Bison men's basketball team''' represented [[Bucknell University]] during the [[2012–13 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Bison, led by fifth year head coach [[Dave Paulsen]], played their home games at [[Sojka Pavilion]] and were members of the [[Patriot League]]. They finished the season 28–6, 12–2 in Patriot League play to be crowned regular season champions. They were also champions of the [[2013 Patriot League men's basketball tournament|Patriot League tournament]] to earn an automatic bid to the [[2013 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|2013 NCAA tournament]].
